title: Birthplace on Tarragona Street and a musical family
summary: Ida was born in Pensacola on Tarragona Street; her mother and father came from Florida towns and both played piano, as do her sisters.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Let me ask you some more questions about your life. Alright. Where were you born?

Right here in Scola, Florida. I was born on the corner of 7th Avenue and, uh, no I wasn't, I was born on the 400 block on Tarragona Street during the time, uh, when they had that hotel down there for a couple of people years ago.
T-A-R-R-A-G-O-N-I-A. That's the same street, Will?
That we are living on right today.

Ten blocks of what? Nine further, that's when my mother first came over to visit my father. I was having to be born in Pensacola. Where's your mother from? My mother was home from Mariana, Florida. I see.
And my father from River Junction, Florida.
Did your mother play music? Yes, she did.
She played piano. And your father?
You got any other piano players in your family?
Oh yes. I have four more sisters. I mean, well, three more sisters plays piano. Living now.
Yeah, well, that's Willie, Edmund, and Sadie. Three of them play piano.
I'm the fourth one. All living. And there are some that have passed, aren't there? Well, yes, I have three passed. Two of them played, but the one passed while she was small. She was a baby Maggie.
She was quite small when she passed.
